rawProofCommandBoundary: Hermetic synthetic proof only. It exercises bounded distributed guardrails depth using deterministic local proof fixtures, synthetic tenants, synthetic actors, synthetic route metadata, proof-local durable counters, two proof nodes, value-free audit evidence, opaque IP-derived references, and explicit non-claims for live WAF, CDN, bot, fraud, edge, gateway, production abuse-prevention, staging, production, SOC, ISO certification, full dev readiness, full React parity, and USF-133 closure.
nonClaims: No full dev readiness, test readiness, staging readiness, production readiness, deployment readiness, live-provider readiness, SOC readiness, ISO certification, enterprise production readiness, full React parity, or USF-133 closure claim is made.
USF-161 bounded proof does not prove live WAF, CDN, bot, fraud, edge, gateway, provider-managed counters, staging, production, or external abuse-control operations.
Synthetic durable counter and multi-node proof does not prove Redis, Postgres, gateway, CDN, WAF, bot, fraud, SIEM, DLP, UEBA, or live provider operation.
Proof-local operator guardrail control-plane events do not create public HTTP guardrail APIs or operator UI readiness.
